name: @feldspar/rss
title: RSS feeds
description: Read an RSS or Atom feed as a table, or observe it as a stream: one row or element per item.
supplies: A table provider, "RSS feed": pick it in New table, give it a feed URL, and the feed's items are the rows.
A stream provider, "RSS feed": create a stream over it and the feed's new items arrive as elements.
